test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"We may have misunderstood the instructions."

options.text: The instructions may have been misunderstood.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "We may have misunderstood the instructions."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the instructions" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "may have misunderstood" to "may have been misunderstood" (present perfect passive form).
 
• Ensure the modal verb "may" remains unchanged in the passive voice sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The instructions may have been misunderstood."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The instructions may be misunderstood." – Incorrect tense (present modal passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The instructions are being misunderstood." – Incorrect aspect (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The instructions may have misunderstood." – Grammatically incorrect (missing passive construction).
